title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting — Part 2: Performance Requirements

clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: IS 16102 (Part 2) specifies performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps including luminous flux, efficacy, colour rendering, and rated life.

clauses.title: Performance Requirements
clauses.text:
Performance requirements for LED lamps (IS 16102 Part 2):
- Initial luminous efficacy: ≥90 lm/W (for lamps ≥10W), ≥80 lm/W (for lamps <10W)
- Lumen maintenance at 3000 hours: ≥90% of initial value
- Lumen maintenance at 6000 hours: ≥80%
- Colour Rendering Index (CRI): ≥70
- Colour Consistency: Within 5 SDCM (Standard Deviation of Colour Matching)
- Power Factor: ≥0.7 (lamps <10W), ≥0.9 (lamps ≥10W)
- Rated life: Minimum 15,000 hours (at L70 — 70% lumen maintenance)
